senses.zh_definition: 施密特：德语来源的姓氏，在马来语文本中作为人名或相关专名使用。
senses.en_definition: Schmidt, a surname of German origin used as a proper name.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang berasal daripada bahasa Jerman dan digunakan sebagai kata nama khas.
senses.nuances: 此处 noun 指专有名词。该马来文释义为说明性编写，并非 DBP 官方释义；不能把姓氏直接译为职业名 tukang besi，也不能仅凭姓氏推断某人的国籍。下列是称谓及姓名组合，不是普通词汇的固定搭配。姓氏来源：[FamilySearch：Schmidt](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=Schmidt)。德语读音：[Schmidt pronunciation](https://forvo.com/word/schmidt/)。

etymology.historical_story: Schmidt began as an occupational surname associated with smithing. FamilySearch traces it to Middle High German smit and relates it to modern German Schmied, meaning a smith or metalworker. A hereditary surname preserves that historical association even when its bearer follows a completely different occupation. In Malay writing, it identifies a person or family rather than naming the trade. Reference: [FamilySearch：Schmidt](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=Schmidt).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Schmidt 与英语 Smith 都联系到铁匠这一历史职业；现代遇到 Schmidt，要先认作姓氏“施密特”。
